headline: AC Service in Perungudi, Built for OMR's Rental Pace
intro: Perungudi sits in the busiest stretch of the OMR corridor — Tidel Park on one side, Thoraipakkam on the other, and thousands of rented flats, PGs and bachelor apartments in between. ACs here work for a living. They run through 40°C afternoons, fight marsh-side humidity drifting in from the Pallikaranai side, and swallow construction dust off the service roads. Airam AC Service keeps them running, with same-day slots and technicians who reach most of Perungudi in 60-90 minutes.

Half our Perungudi bookings come with a move attached. A tenant shifting out of Seevaram needs an uninstallation and a proper service record for the deposit. A landlord in Kandanchavadi wants the split unit deep-cleaned before the next occupant walks in. We handle both sides of that transaction: pricing agreed before work starts, GST-registered digital invoices you can forward for reimbursement, and up to a 90-day warranty on repairs so the handover holds.

Airam is family-run. Our founder learned the trade on service calls in his father's AC business before starting his own, and it shows in the details — background-verified, uniformed technicians, no surprise line items, and honest advice when a repair is not worth the money. We service every major brand you will find in a Perungudi flat: Daikin, LG, Voltas, Blue Star, Samsung, Carrier, Hitachi, O General, Mitsubishi Electric and Panasonic.
neighbourhoods: Doshi Etopia and nearby apartment blocks

challenges.title: Dust-choked filters from OMR traffic
challenges.description: Flats facing the service road pull in a steady film of road and construction dust. Filters clog within weeks, airflow drops, and power bills creep up while cooling gets worse.

challenges.title: Marsh-side humidity and coil corrosion
challenges.description: Damp air off the Pallikaranai marsh keeps coils wet and corrodes fins faster than in inland areas. The first sign is usually a musty smell when the AC starts.

challenges.title: ACs left idle between tenants
challenges.description: Rental churn means units sit switched off for weeks, then run twelve hours a day for a new occupant. Gas seeps out through dried seals, and capacitors fail on restart.

challenges.title: Voltage swings in older blocks and PGs
challenges.description: Shared metering and overloaded wiring in older buildings and PG accommodation cause voltage fluctuations that stress PCBs and compressors, especially on peak summer evenings.

faqs.question: How quickly can a technician reach Perungudi?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day slots across Perungudi, and technicians typically reach homes in covered areas within 60-90 minutes. Flats along the OMR service road, Seevaram and Kandanchavadi are all on our regular circuit.

faqs.question: Do you cover all parts of Perungudi?
faqs.answer: Yes. We serve the full stretch from the Taramani border to Thoraipakkam, including Seevaram, Kandanchavadi, the MRTS station area, the industrial estate and the apartment blocks off the OMR service road.

faqs.question: What AC problems are most common in Perungudi?
faqs.answer: Three come up constantly: coil corrosion from marsh-side humidity, dust-clogged filters from OMR traffic, and gas loss in units left idle between tenants. A seasonal deep clean and a pre-summer check prevent most of them.

faqs.question: Is AC service pricing in Perungudi the same as the rest of Chennai?
faqs.answer: Yes, our rates are uniform across the city. Basic split AC service starts from ₹499, deep cleaning from ₹799 and gas top-ups from ₹1,499, all confirmed upfront. Every job is billed on a GST digital invoice, which helps when a landlord is reimbursing the cost.
